metric_definition: Cumulative volume-weighted normalized seven-field MSE over frames 1:H; normalization scales are fitted to 80 training trajectories. Mean over cases, not a relative percentage error. Ground truth exists only through frame 96.
comparison_case_selection: First two held-out trajectories; same cases as pre-existing64updatepilot; no video-based selection.
caveats: Historical training times sum only recorded optimizer-update wall durations; checkpoint IO/setup/evaluation excluded and concurrent jobs may differ. Not a matched training-compute comparison.
Baselines trained 2000updates; latest learned implicit correction trained64updates and transferred to audited source-axis corrected physics.
Native ground truth CPUwall and new warm GPUrollout wall have differenthardware and IO scope.

followup_protocol.purpose: Explore whether the observed coarse-step speed/accuracy trade-off also holds on the second predefined held-out case.
followup_protocol.selection_note: Exploratory follow-up after seeing first-case results; same frozen weights, no retraining, primary comparison remains two implicit microsteps.
